HOME.INFO_WOM: WOM - "Worth One Minute" is a general-purpose reward platform based on a voucher exchange system. Many actions and activities performed by individuals have an intrinsic social value, an effect known in economics as a "positive externality". WOM aims to recognize all those actions that constitute a socially valuable contribution to a common goal, rewarding the time people dedicate to these activities through the generation of digital social vouchers. WOM vouchers reward every minute of social commitment.

VALUE.TITLE: value
VALUE.DESC: Many everyday actions generate value that goes beyond personal benefit: they have a positive impact on the community. WOM recognises this social value and turns it into a tangible opportunity, rewarding positive externalities through the issuance of WOM vouchers.

ACTIONS.TITLE: actions
ACTIONS.DESC: Every time you carry out a socially responsible action, you earn WOM. The vouchers are collected and managed via the "WOM Pocket" app, which allows you to store, track and use them easily and instantly.

OFFERS.TITLE: offers
OFFERS.DESC:
WOM vouchers can be used at shops and businesses taking part in the scheme, which offer discounts, services and exclusive benefits. Check out the "Offers" section of WOM Pocket to find all the participating businesses.

If you run a business and would like to join the WOM network, click on the ‘Find out more’ button.

CHALLENGES.TITLE: challenges
CHALLENGES.DESC: With WOM, you can also put yourself to the test. Go to the "Achievements" section in "WOM Pocket", take part in the available challenges and collect badges that show your contribution to the community.

FOOTER.DIGIT_DESC: DIGIT srl is a spin-off of the University of Urbino that aims to create social value through digital awareness. DIGIT srl was founded on the belief that technology, platforms, and software must be based on the interests of humans and society, and that social and digital innovation are inextricably linked.
FOOTER.CTE_DESC: CTE Square, House of Emerging Technologies, aims to support research and experimentation projects with the intent of transferring technological know-how to small and medium-sized enterprises to produce increasingly high-quality services.

SECTION_A.A: WOM, short for Worth One Minute, is a social reward platform that recognizes the value of actions contributing to the common good. Through a system of digital vouchers, WOM promotes civic engagement, recognizes the social impact of people's actions, and encourages positive behaviors that benefit communities.
SECTION_A.B: Many everyday activities generate benefits that extend beyond the individual, creating what economists define as positive externalities. WOM makes this value visible and measurable by transforming it into digital social vouchers that reward the time dedicated to socially valuable actions.
SECTION_A.C: Through its social reward system, the platform connects citizens, public institutions, associations, universities, businesses, and local merchants, fostering civic participation, sustainability, and the development of more active and inclusive communities.

SECTION_A_2.TITLE: What are WOM?
SECTION_A_2.A: WOM are digital vouchers that recognize the social value of an action. Each WOM corresponds to one minute of commitment dedicated to an activity recognized as socially valuable and represents a concrete way to reward positive actions.
SECTION_A_2.B: WOM vouchers do not represent money and have no economic value. They are a testimony of an effort made in support of a shared cause and can be used at participating merchants on the platform, who freely choose to offer products, services, or benefits to WOM holders.
SECTION_A_2.C: WOM vouchers are also completely anonymous: the information collected only concerns the social purpose for which they were generated, together with the location and time of their issuance, ensuring the protection of users' privacy.

SECTION_B.TITLE: The Story of WOM
SECTION_B.A: WOM was born as a research project developed by DIGIT, a spin-off of the University of Urbino Carlo Bo, with the aim of measuring and recognizing the social impact of everyday actions through a social reward platform dedicated to civic engagement.
SECTION_B.B: Over time, the project has evolved, involving public administrations, universities, associations, businesses, and local communities in initiatives focused on sustainability, sustainable mobility, culture, volunteering, and social innovation. Thanks to this ecosystem, WOM has become a tool to encourage citizen participation and promote behaviors oriented toward the common good.
SECTION_B.C: In 2025, WOM entered a new phase of its evolution by introducing a renewed visual identity, with a new logo and a redesigned graphic style for the WOM Pocket app. At the same time, new features were introduced, including the Achievements section, which allows users to track their progress, participate in challenges, and collect badges related to the results achieved.

HOW_IT_WORKS.TITLE: How do they work?
HOW_IT_WORKS.DESC_1: WOM Challenges make the experience within WOM Pocket more engaging by transforming civic engagement and activities that contribute to the common good into an interactive journey of achievement and recognition.
HOW_IT_WORKS.DESC_2: Joining a challenge is simple: just scan the QR Code associated with it. Once scanned, the challenge is automatically activated in the app, allowing the user to start completing the required objectives.
HOW_IT_WORKS.DESC_3: Each challenge offers a dedicated journey that values the user's commitment through a system of social gamification. By completing the required activities, users can unlock badges that certify achieved milestones and showcase their contribution to the community.
HOW_IT_WORKS.DESC_4: All earned badges, together with those still waiting to be unlocked, can be viewed in the Achievements section of WOM Pocket, where users can monitor their progress and follow their journey across the platform.

PUBLIC_AND_PRIVATE.TITLE: Public and Private Challenges
PUBLIC_AND_PRIVATE.DESC_1: Within WOM Pocket there are two types of challenges, designed to offer different experiences and encourage active citizenship.
PUBLIC_AND_PRIVATE.DESC_2: Public challenges are accessible to all users and allow them to earn badges simply by using the app and participating in available initiatives. The badges earned become part of their collection and remain always available in the Achievements section.
PUBLIC_AND_PRIVATE.DESC_3: Private challenges, on the other hand, are dedicated to specific events, projects, or initiatives and are activated exclusively by scanning a dedicated QR Code. Only by participating in these challenges is it possible to obtain exclusive badges, designed to recognize involvement in specific activities promoted by institutions, associations, businesses, or local communities.
PUBLIC_AND_PRIVATE.DESC_4: Each badge represents recognition of the journey completed and reflects the user's commitment to activities promoted by the WOM community, encouraging positive behaviors and increasingly active participation.

PUBLIC.TITLE: Universal Badges
PUBLIC.DESC_1: Universal badges can be earned through public challenges, designed for all WOM Pocket users. Public challenges allow users to freely participate in initiatives focused on sustainability, culture, mobility, and other social innovation projects. Through these challenges, users can earn badges, track their progress, and actively contribute to community life.

PRIVATE.TITLE: Exclusive Badges
PRIVATE.DESC_1: Exclusive badges can be earned through private challenges. Private challenges are created for specific events, campaigns, or projects promoted by public institutions, associations, universities, or businesses. Access is granted through a dedicated QR Code and allows users to participate in exclusive journeys, obtain reserved badges, and contribute to initiatives with high social impact.

HOW_TO_GENERATE.TITLE: Actions That Generate WOM
HOW_TO_GENERATE.DESC_1: Every day we perform actions that can create a positive impact on the community: moving sustainably, participating in events, studying, taking care of our health or contributing to social initiatives.
HOW_TO_GENERATE.DESC_2: The WOM platform recognizes the social value of these activities and transforms them into digital social vouchers, rewarding the time dedicated to actions considered valuable for the common good.
HOW_TO_GENERATE.DESC_3: The activities recognized by the platform can cover different areas, from sustainability to mobility, from culture to volunteering, up to personal wellbeing and civic participation.
HOW_TO_GENERATE.DESC_4: Every minute dedicated to an activity approved by the platform can become a WOM: a digital recognition that values people’s contribution and creates a connection between citizens, organizations and local communities.

COLLECT_WOM.TITLE: Collect Your WOM with WOM Pocket
COLLECT_WOM.DESC_1: To collect, store and use the vouchers obtained through your actions, you can use WOM Pocket, the app dedicated to managing your WOM vouchers.
COLLECT_WOM.DESC_2_1: collect digital vouchers generated by your activities;
COLLECT_WOM.DESC_2_2: monitor your contribution to the community;
COLLECT_WOM.DESC_2_4: discover offers and benefits from participating merchants;
COLLECT_WOM.DESC_3: Download WOM Pocket and transform your everyday actions into social value.

HOW_TO_EARN.TITLE: How to Earn WOM
HOW_TO_EARN.DESC_1: To earn WOM, simply participate in activities and initiatives recognized by the platform.
HOW_TO_EARN.DESC_2: Each action is connected to a WOM Instrument, a project, organization or initiative approved by the platform that allows the generation of digital vouchers linked to specific social goals.
HOW_TO_EARN.DESC_3: The number of WOM earned depends on the type of activity performed: every minute recognized by the platform contributes to generating vouchers connected to a specific social purpose.
HOW_TO_EARN.DESC_4: Discover all the activities that allow you to generate WOM.

WOM_FIT.TITLE: WOM Fit
WOM_FIT.DESC_1: With WOM FIT, you can transform the time dedicated to physical activity into digital WOM vouchers.
WOM_FIT.DESC_2: Walking and cycling become actions recognized by the platform because they contribute to personal wellbeing, health, and sustainable mobility.
WOM_FIT.DESC_3: After the first 15 minutes of activity, every additional minute generates WOM dedicated to the health and wellbeing category. Moreover, by choosing to walk or cycle during peak hours, you can contribute to reducing traffic and emissions, earning WOM linked to sustainable mobility.
WOM_FIT.DESC_4: Through WOM FIT, a simple everyday choice such as moving actively becomes a concrete contribution to the community and the environment.

NETWORKING.TITLE: Networking
NETWORKING.DESC_1: Relationships between people generate social value.
NETWORKING.DESC_2: Through networking activities, communities and shared experiences, users can create new connections, exchange knowledge and strengthen their sense of belonging.
NETWORKING.DESC_3: WOM recognizes the value of interactions that promote collaboration and active participation, transforming the time dedicated to building meaningful relationships into a contribution recognized by the platform.
NETWORKING.DESC_4: Through the “Connections” section of WOM Pocket, you can exchange your contact details with other WOM users, expand your network and create new opportunities for collaboration.

GRATITUDE.TITLE: Gratitude
GRATITUDE.DESC_1: Even a simple gesture of gratitude can generate value for the community.
GRATITUDE.DESC_2: Through acts of appreciation and sharing, users can promote supportive behaviours and encourage a culture based on mutual help and cooperation.
GRATITUDE.DESC_3: WOM values these actions as expressions of civic participation and social commitment, recognizing the contribution of people who choose to support and encourage other members of the community.
GRATITUDE.DESC_4: Through the WOM Pocket app, you can share up to 60 WOM per day with another user by accessing the “Exchange” section.
GRATITUDE.DESC_5: Sharing WOM does not represent a transfer of money, but a way to recognize and enhance the social contribution of people.

UNIURB.TITLE: UniUrb
UNIURB.DESC_1: The University of Urbino Carlo Bo recognizes the social value of education and learning through WOM.
UNIURB.DESC_2: Students can earn digital WOM vouchers by dedicating time to their university journey and contributing to the growth of knowledge and the academic community.
UNIURB.DESC_3: Through this Instrument, education becomes a socially valuable action, encouraging learning, participation, and personal development while creating lasting social impact.

ADRIABUS.TITLE: Adriabus
ADRIABUS.DESC_1: Adriabus recognizes the value of sustainable mobility and responsible behaviours connected to public transportation.
ADRIABUS.DESC_2: Thanks to the collaboration with the WOM platform, users can earn digital WOM vouchers by using public transport services and contributing to a more conscious and environmentally friendly mobility model.
ADRIABUS.DESC_3: Using public transportation helps reduce traffic and emissions, supporting a more sustainable territory.
ADRIABUS.DESC_4: Earn WOM every time you purchase a travel ticket or subscription online through the Adriabus website or the MooneyGo app.

EVENTS.TITLE: Event Participation
EVENTS.DESC_1: Participating in events, initiatives and community activities means contributing to the life of the territory.
EVENTS.DESC_2: Through cultural, social, educational or sustainability-focused events, users can earn WOM thanks to their active participation.
EVENTS.DESC_3: WOM collaborates with public institutions, associations, event organizers, universities and local organizations that want to enhance citizen participation and transform their initiatives into opportunities to generate digital social vouchers.
EVENTS.DESC_4: Are you organizing an event or a community initiative? Contact us at info@wom.social to discover how to become a WOM Instrument.

CULTURAL_PLACES.TITLE: Visiting Cultural Places and Heritage Sites
CULTURAL_PLACES.DESC_1: Discovering cultural heritage generates knowledge, participation and value for local communities.
CULTURAL_PLACES.DESC_2: Visiting museums, historical sites, cultural venues and places of interest allows users to connect with the history and identity of territories, transforming cultural experiences into actions recognized by the WOM platform.
CULTURAL_PLACES.DESC_3: WOM promotes cultural participation and heritage valorization by creating new connections between citizens, places and institutions.
CULTURAL_PLACES.DESC_4: Are you a museum, cultural organization or do you manage a historical or artistic site? Join the WOM ecosystem and transform cultural visits and activities into opportunities to generate social value.
CULTURAL_PLACES.DESC_5: Contact us at info@wom.social to discover how to become a WOM Instrument.

VOLUNTEERING.TITLE: Volunteering
VOLUNTEERING.DESC_1: Time dedicated to others is one of the most important forms of social value.
VOLUNTEERING.DESC_2: Through volunteering activities, users can actively contribute to community wellbeing and receive WOM as recognition of their commitment.
VOLUNTEERING.DESC_3: WOM values volunteering as an action capable of generating positive social impact, supporting initiatives, associations and organizations that promote solidarity, inclusion and civic participation.
VOLUNTEERING.DESC_4: Are you an association, a non-profit organization or a group promoting volunteering activities? Transform the time and commitment of your volunteers into a recognized contribution through WOM.
VOLUNTEERING.DESC_5: Contact us at info@wom.social to discover how to become a WOM Instrument.

CODYMAZE.TITLE: CodyMaze
CODYMAZE.DESC_1: CodyMaze is an outdoor chessboard made up of 25 interactive squares where students move like robots by following instructions displayed on their smartphones.
CODYMAZE.DESC_2: Each experience is unique, as the maze changes every time a new player begins, creating an engaging way to explore the fundamentals of coding.
CODYMAZE.DESC_3: By combining play, technology, and education, CodyMaze helps students develop logical thinking and problem-solving skills while earning WOM through an innovative social learning experience.

AWORLD.TITLE: AWorld
AWORLD.DESC_1: AWorld is an app that encourages people to adopt a more sustainable lifestyle by turning everyday choices into positive actions for the planet.
AWORLD.DESC_2: Thanks to the collaboration between DIGIT and AWorld, users can convert eligible sustainable actions into digital WOM vouchers.
AWORLD.DESC_3: Reducing your environmental footprint, making conscious choices, and participating in sustainability initiatives all become recognized actions that generate positive social impact and earn WOM.

BALANCE.TITLE: Balance
BALANCE.DESC_1: Balance – Postural Stability © is an app developed by researchers at the University of Urbino Carlo Bo that measures your postural stability using your smartphone.
BALANCE.DESC_2: By performing regular balance assessments, users can monitor their physical well-being while contributing valuable data that supports health-related research.
BALANCE.DESC_3: To start collecting WOM, you need to complete two measurements on two different days.
BALANCE.DESC_4: With Balance, taking care of your health becomes a socially valuable action, rewarded through digital WOM vouchers that recognize your commitment to personal well-being.

ECOSYSTEM.TITLE: The WOM Ecosystem
ECOSYSTEM.DESC_1: The WOM platform brings together different stakeholders who collaborate to recognize, enhance, and encourage actions that generate a positive social impact.
ECOSYSTEM.DESC_2: Within the WOM ecosystem, each participant plays a specific role: People carry out socially valuable actions and receive digital WOM vouchers as recognition of their contribution; Merchants enhance the value of these vouchers by offering products, services, or benefits to the community; Instruments enable WOM generation through initiatives and projects recognized by the platform.
ECOSYSTEM.DESC_3: Together, these actors create a virtuous cycle in which citizens, organizations, and local businesses collaborate to promote civic engagement, support the common good, and strengthen the connection between people and their communities.

THREE_SUBJECTS.TITLE: The Three Stakeholders of the WOM Platform
THREE_SUBJECTS.DESC_2: People are the users who participate in the WOM ecosystem by taking part in activities recognized as socially valuable.
THREE_SUBJECTS.DESC_3: Through the WOM Pocket app, they can collect, store, and use the digital vouchers earned through their commitment and participation.Every action contributes to creating value for the community and is recognized through a social reward system designed to encourage active participation and positive behaviors
THREE_SUBJECTS.DESC_5: Merchants are businesses, organizations, and local activities that join the WOM network by offering products, services, or benefits in exchange for WOM vouchers.
THREE_SUBJECTS.DESC_6:
Through their offers, Merchants help recognize and reward citizens' positive actions while strengthening the relationship between local communities, businesses, and territories.
By joining the WOM ecosystem, Merchants become active participants in a model of community engagement and social innovation.
THREE_SUBJECTS.DESC_8: Instruments are the entities that enable WOM generation within the platform. They can be initiatives, projects, public institutions, universities, associations, or organizations recognized by WOM that promote activities capable of creating a positive impact on communities.
THREE_SUBJECTS.DESC_9: Through Instruments, socially valuable activities are connected to the platform's social goals and transformed into opportunities for citizens to participate, contribute, and earn digital WOM vouchers.
THREE_SUBJECTS.DESC_10: Together, People, Merchants, and Instruments create an ecosystem of social innovation where every positive action can be recognized, valued, and shared.

WHO_ARE_PEOPLE.TITLE: Who Are People?
WHO_ARE_PEOPLE.DESC_1: People are all users who choose to become part of the WOM ecosystem, contributing to the common good through their actions and actively participating in community life.
WHO_ARE_PEOPLE.DESC_2: Through WOM Pocket, the app for civic engagement that rewards positive actions, every user can collect, store, and redeem the digital vouchers earned by taking part in activities recognized by the platform.
WHO_ARE_PEOPLE.DESC_3: The app is free and available for Android and iOS devices. It represents the main access point to the WOM ecosystem, allowing users to manage their vouchers, explore available offers, track their achievements, and monitor completed challenges.

ACTIONS_HOW_TO_EARN_WOM.TITLE: Actions: How to Earn WOM
ACTIONS_HOW_TO_EARN_WOM.DESC_1: Many everyday actions create value that goes beyond individual benefit. They contribute to the common good and generate a positive social impact within the community.
ACTIONS_HOW_TO_EARN_WOM.DESC_2: When an activity is recognized by the WOM platform as socially valuable, every minute of commitment generates a digital social voucher. In this way, WOM encourages civic participation by recognizing the time dedicated to sustainability initiatives, volunteering, culture, and other community-focused projects.
ACTIONS_HOW_TO_EARN_WOM.DESC_3: WOM vouchers can be earned by participating in initiatives, events, projects, or activities approved by the platform. Once generated, they are automatically collected in WOM Pocket, where users can view their balance, track their progress, and follow their journey within the ecosystem.

OFFERS_HOW_TO_USE_WOM.TITLE: Offers: How to Use WOM
OFFERS_HOW_TO_USE_WOM.DESC_1: Digital WOM vouchers can be used at participating merchants and organizations that choose to offer products, services, discounts, or benefits to WOM holders.
OFFERS_HOW_TO_USE_WOM.DESC_2: All available opportunities can be found in the Offers section of WOM Pocket, where users can discover participating partners and redeem their vouchers according to each merchant's conditions.
OFFERS_HOW_TO_USE_WOM.DESC_3: In this way, WOM creates an ecosystem where positive actions are recognized and rewarded, strengthening the connection between citizens, local businesses, and communities.
OFFERS_HOW_TO_USE_WOM.DESC_4: Through this model of social rewarding, WOM promotes active participation and enhances the social impact generated by individuals and organizations.Are you a business owner interested in offering benefits to WOM holders? Discover how to become a Merchant and join a network that supports civic engagement, local communities, and proximity businesses.
OFFERS_HOW_TO_USE_WOM.DESC_5: Map of Active Merchants with WOM Offers

WHO_THEY_ARE_AND_HOW_TO_JOIN.TITLE: Who Are Merchants and How to Join
WHO_THEY_ARE_AND_HOW_TO_JOIN.DESC_1: Merchants are businesses, local shops, organizations, and institutions that join the WOM ecosystem by offering products, services, discounts, or benefits in exchange for digital WOM vouchers.
WHO_THEY_ARE_AND_HOW_TO_JOIN.DESC_2: Through the WOM platform, Merchants can strengthen their role within the community by supporting positive behaviors and contributing to initiatives related to civic engagement, sustainability, and social impact.
WHO_THEY_ARE_AND_HOW_TO_JOIN.DESC_3: Joining the WOM network means becoming part of a social reward system where citizens' positive actions are recognized and transformed into concrete opportunities for local communities.
WHO_THEY_ARE_AND_HOW_TO_JOIN.DESC_4: WOM offers do not involve monetary exchanges: vouchers represent the recognition of a socially valuable contribution and can only be redeemed for discounts, services, or free benefits made available by the Merchant.
WHO_THEY_ARE_AND_HOW_TO_JOIN.DESC_5: Would you like to join the WOM network?
WHO_THEY_ARE_AND_HOW_TO_JOIN.DESC_6: Download the WOM POS app on your mobile device and start creating your offers.

WOM_POS_TOOL_FOR_MERCHANTS.TITLE: WOM POS: The Tool for Merchants
WOM_POS_TOOL_FOR_MERCHANTS.DESC_1: The main tool for accepting WOM vouchers is WOM POS (Point of Sale), the dedicated application that allows Merchants to manage WOM transactions and verify the validity of received vouchers.
WOM_POS_TOOL_FOR_MERCHANTS.DESC_2: The WOM POS app can be downloaded for free from Android and iOS stores and does not include any transaction fees.
WOM_POS_TOOL_FOR_MERCHANTS.DESC_3: Merchants who want to increase their visibility within the WOM network and receive periodic reports about the social impact generated through their offers can access additional dedicated services.

HOW_TO_CREATE_AND_DELETE_OFFERS.TITLE: How to Create and Remove Offers
HOW_TO_CREATE_AND_DELETE_OFFERS.DESC_1: Through WOM POS, the app designed for Merchants, businesses can easily create and manage their WOM offers.
HOW_TO_CREATE_AND_DELETE_OFFERS.DESC_2: Offer management is fully customizable: Merchants can create, edit, activate, or remove offers according to their needs and ongoing initiatives.
HOW_TO_CREATE_AND_DELETE_OFFERS.DESC_3: By creating WOM offers, businesses can reward citizens' positive actions while strengthening their connection with the local community and participating in a model of community engagement and social innovation.
HOW_TO_CREATE_AND_DELETE_OFFERS.DESC_4: To discover all available features and learn how to manage your offers, consult the WOM Offers Management Guide.

MORE_INFORMATION.TITLE: More Information
MORE_INFORMATION.DESC_1: Would you like to learn more about joining the WOM network, creating dedicated offers for your customers, or enhancing your contribution to the community?
MORE_INFORMATION.DESC_2: Contact us to receive more information about the project and the participation process.

WHO_ARE_INSTRUMENTS.TITLE: What Are Instruments?
WHO_ARE_INSTRUMENTS.DESC_1: Instruments are the entities that generate WOM and enable the platform to recognize and enhance activities with a positive social impact.
WHO_ARE_INSTRUMENTS.DESC_2: An Instrument can be an initiative, a project, a public institution, or an organization recognized by the WOM platform. Through their Instrument, these entities allow users to take part in socially valuable activities and receive digital WOM vouchers as recognition of their contribution.
WHO_ARE_INSTRUMENTS.DESC_3: Each Instrument connects a specific activity to one of the social goals promoted by the platform, known as aims. Aims represent the areas that WOM supports, such as sustainable mobility, public health, culture, the preservation of cultural heritage, education, and personal development.
WHO_ARE_INSTRUMENTS.DESC_4: Through Instruments, institutions, associations, and organizations can transform their initiatives into opportunities for civic engagement, involving citizens and encouraging active participation in the common good.

WHO_CAN_BECOME_AN_INSTRUMENT.TITLE: Who Can Become a WOM Instrument?
WHO_CAN_BECOME_AN_INSTRUMENT.DESC_1: Any organization that promotes activities or initiatives capable of generating recognized social value can become a WOM Instrument.
WHO_CAN_BECOME_AN_INSTRUMENT.DESC_8: entities developing projects focused on sustainability, civic participation, and social innovation.
WHO_CAN_BECOME_AN_INSTRUMENT.DESC_9: Every new Instrument is evaluated by the WOM platform through an ethical and technical review process to ensure that the proposed activity represents a concrete, measurable, and meaningful contribution to the community.
WHO_CAN_BECOME_AN_INSTRUMENT.DESC_10: Once approved, an Instrument can generate digital social vouchers and reward people who participate in recognized activities.

ACTIVE_INSTRUMENTS.TITLE: Active Instruments
ACTIVE_INSTRUMENTS.DESC_1: The WOM network includes several Instruments connected to projects and initiatives that promote positive behaviors, community participation, and active citizenship.
ACTIVE_INSTRUMENTS.DESC_2: Through these Instruments, users can earn WOM by taking part in activities related to different areas of social impact, including:

BECOME_A_WOM_INSTRUMENT.TITLE: Become a WOM Instrument
BECOME_A_WOM_INSTRUMENT.DESC_1: Do you have a project or initiative that involves citizens, volunteers, or local communities?
BECOME_A_WOM_INSTRUMENT.DESC_2: Join the WOM ecosystem and transform your activities into tools that recognize and reward social commitment through digital WOM vouchers.

SECTION_A.A: WOM stands for Worth One Minute and is a general-purpose rewarding platform based on a voucher exchange system that rewards the positive impact of actions and activities done by people that contribute to a common good.
SECTION_A.B: Many actions have an intrinsic social value, an effect known as “positive externalities” in economics. WOM recognizes the impact of those actions and provides a tool to reward these positive externalities by issuing WOMs.

SECTION_A_2.TITLE: What are WOMs
SECTION_A_2.A: WOMs are digital vouchers designed to recognize the value of actions having such a positive effect. Each WOM voucher rewards one minute of socially-valuable effort performed by an individual.
SECTION_A_2.B: The WOMs vouchers are anonymous. The only data they store is related to their social purpose and where and when they generate. WOM vouchers do not have value in “real” fiat money. They are proof of a socially-valuable effort that an individual contributed towards a shared cause.
SECTION_A_2.C: The Registry manages the voucher exchange and keeps track of the creation and consumption of WOMs. The WOM platform is a centralized system. The Registry represents the authority that manages the exchange of cryptographic keys (which allow the secure exchange of information) and verifies that vouchers are earned and spent correctly. The Registry does not store the identity of users and their data. WOM vouchers are anonymous, and their use is not tracked.

SECTION_B.TITLE: How do I earn WOMs?
SECTION_B.A: WOM vouchers are gained by voluntarily performing socially-valuable work. Each minute of effort is worth one WOM. For the generation of WOM, the performed activity must be officially recognized by the WOM platform.
SECTION_B.B: To be recognized, activity or initiative must be evaluated as socially valuable and thus approved by the WOM platform ethical committee.

SECTION_C.TITLE: How do I use my WOMs?
SECTION_C.A: Business owners, shopkeepers, public entities, or any other private citizen (generically called Merchants) may freely decide to provide goods, services, or discounts to owners of WOM vouchers. To do so, they create a WOM payment that allows them to choose which kind of effort to reward: WOM vouchers can be filtered by purpose, location, and time. Goods, services, and discounts can be determined freely by the Merchant.

SECTION_A.A: This section is dedicated to WOM for Urbino, the project that, since may 2022, has been launched in the city of Urbino. WOM for Urbino is the first experimentation platform for the WOM proejct. The choice of Urbino as the first city to use WOM comes from the collaboration with DIGIT srl, University of Urbino and City of Urbino, which gave us its patronage.
SECTION_A.B: The project launched on 4 may 2022 during a press conference (you can see the conference Clicking here). Right now citizens, students and turists have various possibilities to obtain WOM and use them to obtain discounts in stores conventioned with the project.

CITIZENS.SECTION_WOM_FOR_PESARO_DESCR:
The City of Pesaro, as part of the city of Pesaro and on the initiative of the Casa della Tecnologie Emergenti, has adopted the WOM digital platform for the active involvement of citizens and tourists. Anyone who participates in cultural initiatives or visits the city of Pesaro sites can earn points, called WOM, which attest to the social value generated by participation.

Each WOM corresponds to one minute of engagement. WOM have no monetary counter value, but are recognised as vouchers by those who wish to reward those who have earned them. Merchants, shopkeepers, public and private organisations can freely decide to grant discounts or concessions on goods and services to WOM holders. The amount of the discount granted and the number of WOMs required to obtain it are at the sole discretion of each shopkeeper, who can set up offers and make them immediately visible on the WOM Pocket application.

At the Civic Museums and Casa Rossini you can also get reductions and free admission on the Card Pesaro Capitale.

The widespread use of WOM encourages social cohesion, active participation in actions of collective interest, and awareness of the value of one's actions.
CITIZENS.SECTION_WOM_POCKET: WOM Pocket (the app for collecting and using WOM)

WOM Pocket is a free app available for Android and iOS that you can freely install without any form of registration. The app allows you to collect and use WOM by scanning specific QRcodes associated with places, events, or actions that contribute to the creation of social value.

The application does not process personal data and guarantees users' anonymity. Your WOM collection is stored exclusively on your device.

By downloading WOM Pocket you have the opportunity to earn WOM by visiting museums and cultural venues, participating the city of Pesaro events and in many other ways that you will have the opportunity to discover. You can use your WOM to enjoy discounts and concessions at participating stores and to purchase the Pesaro Capitale Card at a reduced price!

CITIZENS.SECTION_FAQ_1_D: Do I need to create an account to access WOM Pocket?
CITIZENS.SECTION_FAQ_1_R: No, the WOM platform and WOM Pocket app are completely anonymous. Therefore, your WOMs are only collected on your device. If you uninstall the app without transferring them you lose them.
CITIZENS.SECTION_FAQ_2_D: Can I move my WOMs from one device to another?
CITIZENS.SECTION_FAQ_2_R: Yes, you can transfer your WOMs by accessing the WOM Pocket app settings and starting the export process
CITIZENS.SECTION_FAQ_3_D: Do WOMs have an expiration date?
CITIZENS.SECTION_FAQ_3_R: No, WOMs always remain valid and remain stored in your WOM Pocket. Some merchants, however, may set up offers valid only for recent WOMs
CITIZENS.SECTION_FAQ_4_R: Each WOM is recognition of the value generated by your 1-minute effort. It has no monetary countervalue, but Pesaro Musei and many shopkeepers and merchants offer discounts and concessions to those who have WOM in appreciation.
CITIZENS.SECTION_FAQ_5_D: Can I use WOM only in Pesaro?
CITIZENS.SECTION_FAQ_5_R: No, you can look for other cities where there are contracted merchants, or propose yourself to use WOM in other cities.

At the Civic Museums and Casa Rossini you can also get reductions and free admission on the Pesaro Capital Card. The list of offers is presented in the WOM Pocket app in reverse order of distance from your location. You can recognise shops with offers by seeing the WOM platform label displayed in the shop window.

If you are a shopkeeper/craftsman/shopkeeper, check out the guide and join the project!

PESARO2024.TITLE: PESARO 2024
PESARO2024.SUBTITLE: The value of your participation in the Capital of Culture
PESARO2024.PAGE_DESCR: The City of Pesaro, through the initiative of Casa delle Tecnologie Emergenti, has adopted the WOM platform to recognize and reward the value of active participation of citizens and tourists in the cultural initiatives of Pesaro Italian Capital of Culture 2024.
PESARO2024.SECTION_HOW_WORKS_DESCR:
Earn WOM by attending events, visiting cultural venues, doing socially useful actions, or adopting sustainable behaviors. Each WOM represents one minute of engagement. WOM have no monetary countervalue, but at the Musei Civici and Casa Rossini reductions and gratuities are valid on the Card Pesaro Capitale and are recognised as vouchers by artisans and shopkeepers who wish to reward those who contribute to the creation of social value with discounts or concessions.

WOM Pocket is the free app for Android and iOS that allows users to collect and use WOM while guaranteeing anonymity. See complete guides for tourists, citizens and Pesaro2024 volunteers and hoteliers.
PESARO2024.SECTION_HOW_TO_EARN_WOM_1_DESCR: Special QRcodes, such as the invitation one displayed below, are displayed at Pesaro 2024 venues and events. Scan them with WOM Pocket to earn as many WOM as the number of minutes it takes to attend the event or visit the venue. The invitation QRcode is worth 15 WOM, in recognition of the value you are creating in the minutes you spend reading this page, installing the app and experiencing how it works. Each QRcode can only be scanned once.
PESARO2024.SECTION_HOW_TO_EARN_WOM_2_DESCR: Check out the guides for tourists, citizens, Pesaro2024 volunteers and hoteliers to discover the many ways to earn WOM.
PESARO2024.SECTION_WHERE_TO_USE: Where can you use your WOM?
PESARO2024.SECTION_WHERE_TO_USE_DESCR:
WOM have an important symbolic value: they represent your contribution to Pesaro 2024.
But in Pesaro you can also use WOM to access the discounts and concessions that tradesmen, craftsmen and shopkeepers spontaneously offer to those who have them, as a token of appreciation for the contribution made to Pesaro 2024 with their presence and participation. At the Civic Museums and Casa Rossini you can also get reductions and free admission on the Pesaro Capital Card. The list of offers is presented in the WOM Pocket app in reverse order of distance from your location. You can recognise shops with offers by seeing the WOM platform label displayed in the shop window.

If you are a shopkeeper/craftsman/shopkeeper, check out the guide and join the project!
PESARO2024.SECTION_ENDING_TEXT: Culture is a collective fact, which feeds on the participation of everyone. WOM recognises and rewards your contribution to the Italian Capital of Culture 2024.

SECTION_A.TITLE: Where do i spend my WOMs? How can I reward socially useful actions with WOMs?
SECTION_A.A: Merchants are system components that can create payment instances. They can accept WOM vouchers in exchange for the services and discounts they offer. Merchants can choose what type of vouchers they accept. They can choose: vouchers generated only for a given purpose (thus promoting that social purpose), those generated in a given geographical area (thus encouraging social actions in their reality territorial), or those generated in a defined time interval. The payment instances do not involve money exchanges but only discounts and gratuities.
SECTION_A.B: By accepting specific types of WOM vouchers, Merchants can indirectly contribute to a social campaign, encouraging citizens to contribute to the shared goal with their voluntary efforts. Also, merchants can increase their visibility to the community working towards the shared goal.
SECTION_A.C: Want to be a merchant? Download the WOM POS app on your mobile device.

SECTION_B.TITLE: POS
SECTION_B.A: The tool Merchants can use to accept WOM payment is the app “WOM POS” (Point of Sale) or a custom integration software. These software components allow merchants to create new transactions, applying filters to collected WOM vouchers.
SECTION_B.B: The WOM platform has no cost for the Merchant that wants to use it anonymously. Merchants can freely download the app POS from the Android and iOS stores. There are no transaction costs. If Merchants want to make their offers more visible and have periodic reports of the social value they have helped to generate, they can select paid services.

SECTION_A.TITLE: How can I generate WOMs?
SECTION_A.A: Instruments are system components recognized by the WOM platform and approved by an ethical committee. They can generate vouchers and reward contributors. All owners of social activity or an initiative that allows volunteers to take social action can become Instruments and add to the list of WOM Instruments.
SECTION_A.B: Each Instrument allows the pursuit of one of the social objectives identified by the WOM platform (for example, initiatives for public health, activities for the defense of social rights or the protection of the artistic and cultural heritage, etc.). These objectives are called aims.
SECTION_A.C: The placing on the platform of new Instruments for the release of WOMs has costs related to the review process by the ethics and technical committees, the development of the connectors, and the maintenance of the WOM generation service.

CONTENT: This privacy policy is provided in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (“GDPR”) and applicable data protection laws. It contains all relevant information regarding the processing and management of personal data collected when the WOM Fit application (hereinafter ‘the application’) is installed on a mobile device.
The WOM Fit app allows users to convert their physical activity efforts into anonymous vouchers through the WOM platform.

The WOM Fit app locally collects and processes data related to the user’s fitness activities, as provided by the platform on which the application is installed. On the iOS platform, GPS activation is required, not for tracking user movements but solely to keep the application running in the background for proper functionality.
This data is stored exclusively on the user’s device.
There is no registration process, and therefore, no personal identification or contact information is collected or otherwise processed.
3. Purpose of Data Processing
The purpose of the application is to encourage personal well-being through physical activity, particularly walking and cycling.

The legal basis for data processing is the consent freely given by the user at the time of downloading and first opening the application, allowing WOM Fit to store their activity data locally. This consent is granted for the purposes outlined in section 3.

After installing WOM Fit on their device, the application collects data related to the user’s movement activities through the application programming interfaces provided by Google for Activity Recognition (on Android) or Apple for Motion Usage Description (on iOS).

The activity data refers to whether the user is stationary, walking, cycling, or moving with a vehicle. This data remains on the user’s device and is not shared, except temporarily and in aggregated form to redeem WOM vouchers. The shared data is not stored on any external device.

Data is stored exclusively on the user’s device as long as the application remains installed.

The data collected by WOM Fit is stored exclusively on the user’s device (local data storage). Through this storage, the user has access to a log of their activities.

The Biblioteca Federiciana and Mediateca Montanari of Fano contribute to the WOM platform by giving value to reading books, participating in reading groups or cultural events, creating digital contents and the participating in the project's editorials that have been activated along with the high schools of Fano.

BALANCE.MAIN_CONTENT:
Balance - Postural Stability© is an application developed by researchers at the University of Urbino to evaluate your stability by investigating your stabilometric indices with just your smartphone.
Measure your postural stability every day to earn WOMs!
You can start collecting WOMs after doing a measurement in 2 different days.

CODYMAZE.TITLE: CodyMaze
CODYMAZE.MAIN_CONTENT:
An open-air chessboard of 25 blocks in which the students will move around like robots guided by the instructions that will appear gradually on the smartphone.
A labyrinth that is never the same, which appears different to each player and changes at each entry.
How to get out of it? By putting into practice the basic principles of coding that you assimilate even while playing!
Earn WOMs by having fun!
